texts.zh:
一场反对我们探索接纳灵能潜能的活动正在愈演愈烈。这些异见团体主张对灵能个体进行更严格的监督，全面否定在这一领域进行任何进一步的研究。

如果继续默许他们的活动，可能会威胁到我们理解和利用新兴灵能力量的进程。
texts.en:
A growing rebel movement is voicing opposition to continued efforts to explore and embrace our psionic potential. These dissident groups advocate for stricter oversight of psionic individuals and a wholesale rejection of further research in this area.

If their activities are allowed to continue, it could threaten progress in understanding and mastering our emergent psionic powers.
